title: Accelerate Claude Code over Codex WebSockets
description:
## Goal
Reduce proxy-induced latency for Claude Code root and subagent requests after speculative WebSocket preconnect landed.

## Scope
- Complete attributable observability.
- Remove same-session head-of-line blocking.
- Evaluate generate=false warmup.
- Improve repeated Luna prompt-cache reuse.
- Add bounded pool replenishment for bursts.

## Success Criteria
- Root and child latency can be decomposed from ingress through first upstream output.
- Optimizations preserve incremental/model-switching correctness and resource bounds.
- Race tests, full suite, and retained real Claude Code E2E artifacts validate the result.
close_reason: Completed attributable telemetry, same-session overflow, generate=false A/B, Luna prompt-cache reuse, and bounded burst replenishment. Full tests, race targets, builds, and retained real E2E evidence pass.

title: Evaluate Codex generate=false WebSocket warmup
description:
Hypothesis: after the WebSocket handshake, sending Codex-style response.create with generate=false may warm server-side routing and reduce time from child request_sent to first_upstream_event.

Implement as an opt-in experiment with TDD:
- Reproduce Codex 0.144.5 warmup semantics and completion handling without leaking a warmup response to downstream clients.
- Reuse the warmed socket for the real request and preserve model-switching correctness.
- Bound timeout, failures, 429 behavior, resource use, and fallback to pure preconnect.
- Emit warmup started/ready/failed timings and any returned response ID.

Acceptance:
- Synthetic protocol tests cover success, rejection, cancellation, and real-request reuse.
- Run repeated real A/B samples against pure handshake preconnect.
- Keep the feature only if median first_upstream_event improves materially without extra billed generation or instability; otherwise document and remove/leave disabled.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Synthetic tests cover success, rejection, cancellation, and real-request reuse.
2. Repeated real A/B samples compare against pure handshake preconnect.
3. No warmup response leaks downstream and no billed generation is introduced.
4. Keep enabled only if median first_upstream_event improves materially without instability.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Synthetic tests cover success, rejection, cancellation, and real-request reuse.
2. Repeated real A/B samples compare against pure handshake preconnect.
3. No warmup response leaks downstream and no billed generation is introduced.
4. Keep enabled only if median first_upstream_event improves materially without instability.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in Codex-style generate=false warmup with TDD, model-switching reuse, bounded failure handling, detached telemetry, and retained real A/B. Median request-to-first-event improved only 1.6% while child elapsed regressed 336ms, so feature remains disabled by default.

title: Add attributable Claude WebSocket latency telemetry
description:
Problem: current request logs prove speculative preconnect works, but reused=true conflates session reuse and pool leases, and cross-request root-to-child analysis requires manual timestamp reconstruction.

Implement with TDD:
- Add connection_source values for session_reuse, speculative, cold, retry, and overflow.
- Record session busy/queue time, in-flight preconnect wait, lease misses and miss reasons.
- Record bounded-pool state/counters: idle, dialing, expiry, discard, cooldown rejection.
- Emit normalized incremental reset reasons and usage/cache token metrics without prompt or credential contents.
- Add a stable privacy-safe root/agent correlation field across request artifacts.

Acceptance:
- Structured tests cover every new event and reserved-field protection.
- Existing request logs remain backward compatible.
- A synthetic root-to-Luna test produces a machine-readable phase timeline without parsing raw prompts.
- go test ./..., targeted race tests, and git diff --check pass.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Structured tests cover every new event and reserved-field protection.
2. Existing request logs remain backward compatible.
3. Synthetic root-to-Luna test emits a machine-readable prompt-free phase timeline.
4. Full suite, targeted race tests, and git diff --check pass.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Structured tests cover every new event and reserved-field protection.
2. Existing request logs remain backward compatible.
3. Synthetic root-to-Luna test emits a machine-readable prompt-free phase timeline.
4. Full suite, targeted race tests, and git diff --check pass.
close_reason: Implemented privacy-safe correlation, connection-source attribution, lock contention, normalized usage/cache, incremental reset, and preconnect pool telemetry; targeted, race, full suite, and build pass.

title: Replenish bounded preconnect pool for Agent bursts
description:
Goal: keep later children warm when a root emits a small burst of Agent calls and earlier children consume the initial speculative sockets.

Implement with TDD:
- Replenish only after a successful lease or a newly observed unmatched Agent call.
- Respect the existing global cap, per-route auth isolation, TTL, in-flight accounting, auth generations, and 429 cooldown.
- Coalesce replenishment triggers and prevent reconnect loops after failures.
- Keep the feature independently configurable and disabled unless justified by burst E2E results.

Acceptance:
- Deterministic tests cover two/three parallel children, cap enforcement, failure cooldown, auth removal, expiry, and no duplicate dials.
- Race detector passes under concurrent lease/replenish/close.
- Real bounded burst E2E confirms connection_ready stays warm without exceeding the configured socket cap.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Tests cover parallel children, caps, cooldown, auth removal, expiry, and duplicate suppression.
2. Race detector passes concurrent lease/replenish/close.
3. Real bounded burst E2E keeps connection_ready warm without exceeding the configured cap.
4. Failure paths cannot create reconnect loops.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Tests cover parallel children, caps, cooldown, auth removal, expiry, and duplicate suppression.
2. Race detector passes concurrent lease/replenish/close.
3. Real bounded burst E2E keeps connection_ready warm without exceeding the configured cap.
4. Failure paths cannot create reconnect loops.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in lease replenishment with bounded atomic reservation, duplicate coalescing, cooldown/generation/TTL preservation, detached metrics, parallel/race tests, and retained real 3-child burst E2E; all children used speculative sockets within cap.

title: Measure and improve prompt-cache reuse for Luna agents
description:
Problem: the real Luna child probe reported cacheReadInputTokens=0 despite a root-scoped prompt-cache namespace. We need to distinguish expected first-use behavior from unstable prefixes or keys.

Implement with TDD and controlled E2E:
- Normalize cache read/write/input/output/reasoning usage into structured request metrics.
- Run two or more equivalent Luna children in the same root session and compare cache keys, stable system/tool prefixes, and usage.
- Identify mutations in tool definitions, instructions, identity headers, or request translation that defeat cache reuse.
- Improve only proxy-owned deterministic shaping; do not alter model effort or Claude semantics.

Acceptance:
- Tests prove cache key isolation across auth/model and sharing within the intended root/model scope.
- E2E artifacts retain both raw usage and normalized comparison.
- If cache hits are attainable, the second equivalent Luna request shows cache_read tokens and lower latency; otherwise document the upstream limitation with evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Tests prove cache-key isolation across auth/model and intended sharing within root/model scope.
2. E2E retains raw usage and normalized comparisons for repeated Luna children.
3. Proxy-owned shaping remains deterministic without changing effort or semantics.
4. Cache hits or the upstream limitation are demonstrated with retained evidence.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Tests prove cache-key isolation across auth/model and intended sharing within root/model scope.
2. E2E retains raw usage and normalized comparisons for repeated Luna children.
3. Proxy-owned shaping remains deterministic without changing effort or semantics.
4. Cache hits or the upstream limitation are demonstrated with retained evidence.
close_reason: Added auth/model/root-isolated cache scopes, privacy-safe stable-prefix telemetry, and TDD. Retained real Luna E2E proves equivalent second child reads 4,864 of 5,113 input tokens from cache (95.1%); latency remained variable, so no latency claim.

title: Avoid same-session head-of-line blocking with overflow sockets
description:
Problem: real Claude Code E2E showed the primary request waiting about 2.89 seconds behind a concurrent title-generation request sharing one persistent session socket.

Implement with TDD:
- Detect a busy persistent session before blocking on its request lock.
- If the concurrent request cannot safely continue the active incremental chain, lease a speculative socket or use a one-shot overflow socket.
- Keep previous_response_id and incremental state owned exclusively by the canonical session request.
- Never multiplex two active responses on one upstream WebSocket.
- Preserve auth routing, cancellation, model switching, retry, and session capacity bounds.

Acceptance:
- A deterministic concurrent title-like plus main request test has no lock serialization and uses two sockets.
- Compatible sequential turns still reuse one socket and previous_response_id.
- Cancellation/error paths close overflow resources and do not corrupt canonical state.
- Stress and race tests pass.
- Real Claude Code A/B records session_lock wait and end-to-end improvement.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Concurrent incompatible requests use separate sockets without session-lock serialization.
2. Sequential compatible turns still reuse one socket and previous_response_id.
3. Cancellation and errors do not corrupt canonical incremental state.
4. Stress, race, full suite, and real Claude Code A/B pass.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Concurrent incompatible requests use separate sockets without session-lock serialization.
2. Sequential compatible turns still reuse one socket and previous_response_id.
3. Cancellation and errors do not corrupt canonical incremental state.
4. Stress, race, full suite, and real Claude Code A/B pass.
close_reason: Implemented non-blocking same-session overflow sockets with canonical incremental-state isolation and speculative lease support; 30x stress, race, full suite, build, and real Claude Code E2E passed.

title: Build observable claudex-next launcher
description: Provide a one-command Claude launcher backed by the instrumented CLIProxyAPI. Each run must isolate proxy logs, capture Claude debug/transcript data, emit a manifest and machine-readable latency summary, preserve interactive TTY behavior, enforce bounded subagent defaults, and verify actual root/subagent model routing.
close_reason: Implemented, installed, and verified with a real Sol root -> Luna leaf-agent run; bundle captured WebSocket timelines, both transcripts, routing, cache, latency, and Claude cost/TTFT.

title: Unified Claude + CLIProxyAPI OpenTelemetry observability
description: Build a local development observability stack and export correlated Claude Code plus CLIProxyAPI traces, metrics, and events into Grafana. Preserve privacy-safe defaults, raw per-run evidence, and graceful fallback when Docker or OTLP is unavailable.
close_reason: All child work complete and live E2E verified

title: Manage a persistent local Grafana OTEL-LGTM stack
description: TDD a claudex-next stack manager that lazily starts a pinned grafana/otel-lgtm container, persists data, uses OTLP 4317/4318 and non-conflicting Grafana 3300, health-checks readiness, reuses an existing healthy container, and degrades to file bundles without blocking Claude when Docker is unavailable. Never destroy volumes automatically.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by unit tests and live LGTM smoke

title: Add CLIProxyAPI OpenTelemetry SDK foundation
description: Add configurable OTLP/HTTP and OTLP/gRPC exporters, tracer/meter providers, batch processors, clean shutdown/flush, service resource attributes, and no-op defaults. The proxy must receive claudex.run_id explicitly from the launcher and must not leak prompts, credentials, request bodies, or raw identifiers into telemetry.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by unit tests and live LGTM smoke

title: Export Claude Code metrics events and beta traces
description: Have claudex-next explicitly configure Claude Code OTLP metrics, log events, and enhanced beta traces with short local export intervals, service.name=claude-code, and the shared claudex.run_id. Keep prompt, tool detail/content, and raw API body logging disabled by default. Preserve user-provided OTEL settings through an explicit and documented override policy.
close_reason: Implemented with OTLP export, privacy tests, runtime and WebSocket instrumentation

title: Instrument CLIProxyAPI request and WebSocket spans
description: TDD spans for inbound request, scheduler/auth selection, session lock/overflow, connection acquisition, DNS/TCP/TLS/WebSocket handshake where observable, request send, upstream first event/reasoning/text, translation, downstream first flush, completion, fallback, retry, and error paths. Instrument speculative preconnect as detached spans with links rather than retaining request contexts.
close_reason: Implemented with OTLP export, privacy tests, runtime and WebSocket instrumentation

title: Export low-cardinality proxy performance metrics
description: Convert existing timeline measurements into OTel counters and histograms for request duration, connection readiness/source, upstream TTFT, first text, scheduler wait, pool lease/miss/expiry/failure, fallback/retry/error, cache read ratio, bytes, translation, downstream blocking, and active/idle/dialing pool gauges. Define bounded attributes and tests preventing session IDs, agent IDs, prompts, and fingerprints from becoming metric labels.
close_reason: Implemented with OTLP export, privacy tests, runtime and WebSocket instrumentation

title: Correlate Claude root agent preconnect and child traces
description: Create a cross-process correlation model using claudex.run_id, privacy-safe root/execution IDs, Agent tool-call identity, and W3C trace context when Claude propagates it. Produce parent-child spans or span links for root Agent emission -> speculative dial -> child launch/request -> completion. Test in-session model switching and parallel children without incorrect parentage.
close_reason: Verified Sol/Luna model switching and one shared three-service trace

title: Provision Grafana datasources dashboards and trace links
description: Provision Tempo, Prometheus, and Loki data sources plus dashboards for end-to-end waterfall, root/child routing, p50/p95 latency phases, WebSocket source/hit rate, pool state, prompt-cache effectiveness, model switching, failures, cost/tokens, and process health. Add exemplars and links between metrics, traces, and logs filtered by claudex.run_id.
close_reason: Provisioned and live-verified Grafana dashboard across Tempo Prometheus and Loki

title: Add proxy process and launcher lifecycle telemetry
description: Capture proxy CPU, RSS, goroutines, GC pauses, open connections, exporter queue/drops, process start/readiness/shutdown, Claude launch/exit, and OTLP flush outcome. Attribute only bounded service/run metadata and retain the same facts in the private run manifest when OTLP is unavailable.
close_reason: Implemented with OTLP export, privacy tests, runtime and WebSocket instrumentation

title: Build repeatable paid OTEL end-to-end verification
description: Run a budget-guarded Sol root -> Luna leaf child -> Sol continuation scenario through claudex-next. Verify Claude and proxy services appear in Grafana, all signals reach their backends, spans correlate by run ID, child uses speculative WebSocket, model switching is correct, metrics match raw request timelines, exporters flush on short --print sessions, and no sensitive content appears with privacy defaults. Retain checksummed private evidence and a publishable redacted report.
close_reason: Budget-capped paid E2E passed all verification checks; evidence retained
